6004:
[עָמַם] _vb_. **darken**, **dim** (NH _id_.; _Arabic_ **cover**, **veil**, **conceal**; 𝔗 עֲמַם **grow dark**);—
**Qal** Pf. 3 pl. sf. עֲמָמֻהוּ [[26-ezekiel.31.8|Ez 31:8]] dub., but prob. (as Thes) cedars **did** not **eclipse him**; עֲמָמוּךָ [[26-ezekiel.28.3|28:3]] no secret **do they hold dark** (= is held dark) for thee (Ges § 117 x).
**Hoph**. Impf. 3 ms. יוּעַם זָהָב [[25-lamentations.4.1|La 4:1]] (fig.) **how is the gold dimmed!** cf. Bu.
